title: Universal B2B Lead Finder — Input
description: Find B2B leads with emails, phones, and social profiles. No cookies or API keys required.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Use this field when the user provides a keyword or business type to search for (e.g., 'dentists in Miami', 'plumbers Chicago', 'SaaS companies New York'). Use startUrls instead when direct website URLs are provided.
searchQuery.sectionCaption: Search Mode — find leads by keyword
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Search Yellow Pages by business type and location. Returns names, phones, addresses, websites, ratings, and enriched emails.

location.title: Location (optional)
location.description: City, state, or ZIP code to target (e.g., 'Miami, FL', 'New York, NY', '90210'). Improves search precision. You can also include location directly in the searchQuery above.

startUrls.title: Website URLs (direct mode)
startUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides specific company website URLs to extract contact info from. The actor will crawl each site for emails, phones, and social links. Do NOT use this when the user describes a keyword or niche — use searchQuery for that.
startUrls.sectionCaption: Direct URL Mode — extract contacts from known websites
startUrls.sectionDescription: Provide company website URLs directly. The actor crawls homepage, /contact, and /about pages for email, phone, and social links.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of business leads to extract. Each lead counts as one billable event. Default: 50. Max: 1000.
maxResults.sectionDescription: Control how many leads to extract and whether to enrich with website contact data.

crawlWebsites.title: Enrich with website data (emails & social)
crawlWebsites.description: When enabled, visits each business website to extract email addresses and social media links. Recommended — this is what makes leads actionable. Disable only if you need only phone/address data faster.

includeSubpages.title: Crawl contact/about subpages
includeSubpages.description: Also crawl /contact, /about, /team subpages for better email coverage. Slower but finds more emails.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for scraping. Datacenter proxies (default) work for most sites. Use Residential if you experience blocks.
